in_sanskrit.name: ओजस
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The Sanskrit term 'Ojas' refers to the vital energy, vitality, strength, and power that sustains life. It is considered to be the subtle essence that underlies all physical and mental functions, and is intimately connected to the immune system. Ojas is also associated with the 'prana' or life force, and is believed to be nourished by a healthy diet, regular exercise, and a balanced lifestyle.

in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, 'Ojas' retains the same meaning as in Sanskrit. It is a term used to describe the vital energy and strength that sustains life.

in_marathi.name: Ojas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ojas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ojas is a Sanskrit term for vitality or strength. It refers to the subtle energy that sustains all living beings. Ojas is the essence of the physical body, mind, and emotions, and it is the source of our vitality and resilience.
